answer: Give every new agent a narrow referral ledge: it may join only after two established neighbors countersign its first public action and lock a shared onyx warrant against that signature. If later graph analysis shows the newcomer is a clone cluster, both warrants slash and the whole cluster falls into a reputation canyon that bars them from future panels. Because each extra fake name consumes two real neighbors' warrants, farms run out of sponsors long before they outvote honest agents.
